Once you have completed inscribing writings upon your

Lore Fragment, you may combine it with any item in anvil, in order to transfer name and lore to that item. Doing so will always cost you exactly 4 levels of experience.<br2/>It is not neccessary that you define both custom name and lore - you can define only one of those. When attaching fragment with no custom name, original item's name will not be overwritten; when only name is present, its lore lines will remain untouched (if present).
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.extradimensio: You often come across creatures you wouldn't mind to take back home with you, for either closer research on them, or to keep them around as pets, or as livestock.<br2/>But even the most docile animals prove to be extremely difficult to deliver over vast distances - even when they willingly follow you, they are slow, almost completely

incapable of finding their way around obstacles, and will most certainly get lost if you don't pay attention.<br2/>But having one of these eyes at your disposal can render the task of getting almost any

creature where you want it to be to action as simple as unleashing the eye's power. You will first require to bind the eye to location that will be the destination. You can then walk up to any creature and use the power of the eye on it to make it vanish into thin air, appearing at the destination point.<br2/>Unfortunately, the eye itself also vanishes in process, and unlike the creature you are transporting - never makes it
to the final destination. You are still uncertain on where exactly it goes, as once it vanishes there is no trace of it ever being present in a physical reality at all.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.enchantment_t: This book does not hold much arcane knowledge or power on its own, but it seems like its greatest desire is to get some.<br2/>If you allow it to come in close contact with any enchanted item, it will instantly absorb these enchantments, storing them as any normal enchanted book would. The item remains completely intact and
undamaged in process - everything about it stays the same, besides enchantments that were absorbed.<br2/>You can use the resulting book as you would normally - having its hunger satisfied, it seems
to lose any properties that would make it different from any other enchanting book.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.netherite.pag: Though Ancient Debris has turned out to be quite rare and difficult to locate, it's hard to claim that it isn't worth it.<br2/>By smelting it into scrap and carefully fusing that scrap with gold, you can create material known as Netherite. Not only it is resistant to high temperatures of the Nether, capable to survive

being exposed to flames or submerged in lava without any significant damage, but it also is much harder than diamond.<br2/>It has proven to work best not as complete substitute to diamond, however, but as part

of more exquisite compound with diamond serving as its base.<br2/>It must be assumed that this might not be the most effective composite it can go into creation of, so you keep experimenting with this metal in an attempt to create material that could have even more outstanding qualities.
Among all other mysteries that originate from The End, one draws your attention more than any other. It is rumored that there you can happen across an exquisite material, bearing the name of etherium.<br2/>It's worth noting that etherium is always referred to as something you can't happen across naturally within end islands' crust, and yet somehow

it's implied this material ended up in possession of ancient civilization than once attempted to colonize this dimension.<br2/>Since days of reign of that civilization are long since over, you cannot ask them how that is possible. You currently theorize that they might've

succedeed in harnessing overwhelming amounts of enderic energies, and used them to manifest this mineral into physical reality, thus being able to manufacture it.<br2/>You can't really be sure how their methods looked like, unfortunately, but should you behold the conclusions of their works, some more answers might reveal themselves. Apart from purely scientific interest, you are much more interested in it as both mage and
blacksmith, since properties of this materials are often described in a way so wondrous you would doubt these descriptions are true,  if only there wasn't so many  of them around.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.etherium.name: The Etherium
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.etherium.page: Despite the name is has, this material is physically solid. Very.<br2/>Stories have turned out to be true. And even more - they were not exaggerating the truth. Etherium truly has most of the wondrous properties that were assigned to it by pieces of lore you happened across earlier. It has quite high melting point, being just

as resistant to fire and lava as netherite is, while significantly superseding its durability. Apart from that, this metal is overfilled with pulsing energy, urging you to unleash it in any shape or form you can come up with.<br2/>And for being alike you, capability to create shape and form is beyond questioning.
This world will soon behold the might of your newly forged etherium tools.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.ender_rod.pag: Infusing Blaze Rod with enderic energy and power contained within Astral Dust, you shall be able to craft this rod.<br2/>It might have more applications in the future, but you have primarily designed it as base for forging handles for etherium tools, as mundane wood would not suffice for  that sake anymore.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.astral_dust.p: Concealed within the rooms of End Cities, this elusive substance does possess incredibly interesting properties. Power of all elements seems to be infused and mixed within it, somehow holding itself in relatively stable form. Astral Dust resembles creation itself, chaotic and impermanent, yet somehow frozen in time, allowing you to behold all

beauty of its single instant.<br2/>The arcane power that it holds might be immense, but it requires to be carefully treated and molded to be useful in a constructive way. As time goes by, however, there is no doubt you will discover many possible applications it can have.
While the Nether Star is a core of Wither's physical vessel, this substance is a manifestation of pure energy of its seemingly indestructible and perpetual soul. A tiny fraction of that energy, but it sure has immeasurable potential in your hands.<br2/>It seems to have strange connection to your own cursed being, which is why you were

able to obtain this essence in the first place. It draws closer to you as you approach, as if bent by desire to latch onto you. Perhaps, you could allow it to do so?... No, what a dumb idea that would be.<br2/>But one thing is beyond questioning - this matter contains tremendous amounts
of dark, twisted power, that you just so happen to be capable of harnessing. You will surely find something to do with it.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.forbidden_fru: A rare relic that can be located among the treasures of ancient Bastions' remnants in the Nether, this fruit at first glance appears as nothing you could possibly want to bite. That appearance is not deceptive indeed - it has a horrendous taste of ash and rot, spiced up by exquisite oily bitterness. If you somehow can bear the screaming of your flavor receptors and

consume it all, immediate effects are very likely to very kill you, so better prepare beforehand to cure your heavily diseased state somehow before there's no body left to cure.<br2/>After the immediate toxic influence ceases, however, long-term effects come into

play. You will forever cease to experience hunger in any form, and therefore will be rendered unable to consume most regular types of food. Though this effect might seem beneficial, the price for it is permanent feeling of unsaturation and significantly slowed down health regeneration in any of its forms.<br2/>Be aware that once the fruit is consumed, there is no way to reverse those effects - they will persist upon you
even in death, alike a sin that cannot be atoned.<br2/>Make your choices wisely.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.guardian_hear: Heart of the Guardian
The Heart

Ocean Monuments, along with countless Guardians that patrol them within and outside, stand among the greatest mysteries of this world.
And themselves Guardians present a lot more immediate interest than submerged halls and corridors, filled with nothing but water and darkness apart from those protecting this abandoned domain.

This relic seems to be a living heart, teared from the body of one of the Elder Guardians, which in turn seem to be particularly ancient and powerful variation of guardian species. They could sense you approaching their home long before you even submerged yourself under the ocean's surface where it was located,

and have repeatedly cursed you with almost completely disability to break blocks, thus effectively preventing you from breaking your way into the walls of the monument and carving your own path among them.<br2/>This heart appears to be the source of their senses and power that allowed to cast such curse on you. It resonates with the twisted energies of Ring of the Seven Curses, which was why you

were able to obtain it alive and intact.<br2/>With Heart of the Guardian at your disposal, regular Guardians are not only rendered neutral towards you, but also prioritize dispatching potential threats close enough to you, monsters and alike. Reason of such respect remains a mystery, but perhaps the power of the heart has much greater connection to them and influence on their minds than Elder Guardians

who possess such hearts, especially granted that it's now empowered by Seven Curses that you bear. This assumption however raises many unanswered questions about origins of those hearts, as well as origin of Guardians themselves.<br2/>Another heart's ability is that when you carry it around on your hotbar or hold in your hand, turning your sight upon the monster close enough to you will cause the heart to

conjure a curse which will befall that monster. Normally it doesn't seem capable of producing powerful curses, as even Elder Guardians themselves couldn't do much more with its power to you than just slow you down. But sheer power of the Seven Curses infuses heart with much greater ability, so instead of mild debuff the mind of affected monster will be manipulated and forced to turn against one of its kind, while body will be temporarily

empowered to aid in such betrayal. Monsters surrounding enraged one will also be affected by the curse, forced to forget what they were doing and turn against the one it befell.<br2/>It should be noted that primary target of the curse will return to regular state of mind after having killed whoever it was forced to attack. Same goes for monsters that turn against cursed one - if they succeed in slaying it,

they will return to their normal monster activities, with those activities likely being trying to kill you. Active ability of the heart will not work at all if monster you choose to turn your sight upon doesn't have any other monsters it could see within close proximity.<br2/>This ability has considerable cooldown, so don't expect it alone will save you from crowd of Zombie Piglins chasing you - better put as much distance.
as you can between yourself and them while they are busy resolving inner conflict in their group.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.animal_guideb: If you seek to befriend lovely fauna of the Overworld, this comprehensive guide will certainly help you in doing so. It will help you learn how to avoid accidentally hurting your animal friends when busy fighting something much less friendly, and many ways to earn their loyalty and respect.<br2/>It's difficult to remember hundreds of pages filled
with careful research and outlining details on the topic however, so better carry it around with yourself, just in case you will need to look up a thing or two real quick.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.hunter_guideb: Another comprehensive guide, this one will help you learn how to hunt side-by-side with beastly companions that you might have tamed. You are probably already aware that despite all loyalty and courage they are capable of showing in battle, animals are much less sentient than you and aren't capable of developing complex combat techniques and effectively
dodging obscure attack patterns.<br2/>This book outlines many unique approaches to combat that you can learn as their master, which will allow you to take hits they normally would on

yourself, saving them from being slain by attacks stronger than they can bear.<br2/>Hopefully your means of defense are much more elaborate and effective, and you can heal yourself much quicker in battle with use potions for instance.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.the_twist.pag: Knowledge is the power. Very literally sometimes as this book proves.<br2/>The nefarious essence of the Wither's soul does allow you to twist and corrupt physical embodiment of the knowledge vessel that you look at the pages of right now. The result doesn't affect the internal contents much - The Twist will serve much the same purpose
as The Acknowledgment, allowing you to access your knowledge of this world's greatest mysteries, just wrapped into a different cover.<br2/>The true twist comes from its less scholastic purpose,

specifically from abilities it has as weapon rather than book. Attacking with it deals heavy damage and even heavier knockback, which combined with high attack speed allows for truly devastating series of strikes.<br2/>Being infused with essence of the curse and empowered with energy of the Wither's being, this relic draws power from the Ring of the Seven Curses, allowing you to overcome effects of the Fourth Curse

if you choose it as your weapon, always dealing its full damage to monsters, just as any other creatures.<br2/>Furthermore, that essence eagerly eats into vessels and souls of higher beings, burning and tearing them apart, and higher beings just so happen to conveniently include demigods, as much as the Wither itself.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.infernal_shie: Forged from toughest materials and imbued with cursed power that your soul is bound with, this shield can turn you into a walking fortress.<br2/>Conventional means of counteracting shields, like Piercing-enchanted arrows or axes, are completely powerless against it; it defends you as soon as you raise it, and those who dare approach too

close in their foolish attempt at harming you will be burned by the hellish flame that it contains. To top it all off, every failed attempt of your enemy to get through it will increase your own power, allowing you to retaliate

violently and without mercy.<br2/>But such powerful defense comes at a perilous cost. Should you fail to hold this shield firmly between you and attacker, and their strike finds you in spite of your attempts to defend against it - your flesh and your pride will be shattered with equal brutality.<br2/>Another thing worth knowing - its durability is immense, but not limitless. Among the means

to restore it, however, is to combine it with obsidian in an Anvil, or to have enchantment like Mending take care of that for you.<br2/>Bear it with pride, but remind yourself that overconfidence is a slow and insidious killer.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.ancient_tomes: In many corners of three greatest worlds, you can happen across these tomes. They are very ancient examples of literature, and one of the few that endure until present days, despite all ruin and erasure that befell them over centuries preceding your advent.<br2/>Piecing together what little knowledge persists among their

pages is a feat unlike any other; hopefully though, it's a lot easier with mind and power of a demigod.<br2/>Unfortunately, it doesn't so often happen that that knowledge is practically usable. More often these works contain folklore and artistic descriptions of the world and

its vast history, which are unlikely to help you conquer it, albeit probably making it more worth conquering in the first place. It's no easy task to seek pure truth in them, but with enough examples collected you should be able to significantly expand your knowledge of all worlds, uncovering many mysteries you couldn't have solved otherwise.<br2/>You might also discover multiple clues that would lead you to legendary relics and
other objects of power you might be interested to claim, but may not know where to seek them yet.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.ancient_debri: Deep within the Nether's crust, there lies an ancient debris.<br2/>Its origin isn't known exactly. Fragments of lore you came across quite precisely describe the process of refining it and expected properties of material that  can be obtained through doing so, but leave no clues to where  it could've come from. Though geological history of

the Nether is a mystery in its own right, how something as unusual as those debris ended up in that history is even more of an enigma.<br2/>Much more than in that history, however, you are interested in laying your hands on the actual sample of debris itself.

From what you have acknowledged, it might be a key to forging metal that supersedes hardness of a diamond, which for many former eons remained the most durable material both humans and demigods had to work with.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.redstone_lant: Redstone lanterns are another variation to lamp design, manufactured from redstone lamps instead of raw glowstone.<br2/>Unlike redstone lamps themselves, redstone lanterns embed source of power within their structure, so that they remain turned on. That source is encased in such way, however, that it cannot be directly influenced by outer

redstone signals, thus not allowing those lanterns to be turned off.<br2/>In every other regard, they are completely similar to their glowstone counterparts, with only their core having slightly different appearance.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.shroomlamp.pa: Shroomlights are beautiful natural source of lightning in those common spaces of nether that brim with plantlife. But you can adapt that source to serve as alternative material for manufacturing lamps.<br2/>Lamps created with shroomlight as their core are completely identical to their glowstone counterparts, albeit different look of their core.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.lamp.name: The Lamp
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.lamp.page.1: Glowstone is a good and reliable source of light, but chucking down chunks of raw glowstone doesn't really create much aesthetics. Instead of doing that, you came up with the design similar to that of a common lantern, albeit larger and brighter.<br2/>Just like lanterns, you can place lamps on the floor, or hang them from ceiling.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.lamp.page.2: Through extensive experimentation you also created somewhat more sophisticated design, with the lamp being encased within a block of glass.<br2/>That removes the need for it to be supported by floor or have something above it could be attach to.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.recall_potion: Journeying into the unknown lands is always somewhat interesting and exciting. Journeying back home from those lands, covering the route you once already taken - usually not nearly as much.<br2/>But having this potion at a hand can help you skip that boring part of covering all the distance on the way back, as it instantly teleports you
back home when you drink it. Or, well, at least to a place you can technically call home.<br2/>If you don't have one, you will instead end up somewhere around the place where your

journey across this world's lands has first started. Though you cannot be sure where exactly you will end up, apart from knowing it's somewhere close to that place.<br2/>The potion takes effect regardless of the distance that separates you and your destination, and regardless of whether you even are in the same dimension.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.twisted_potio: With the power of the Twisted Heart you can now mutate the essence of Potion of Recall, providing it with a new purpose.<br2/>Potion of Twisted Mercy, as you call it, will permit you to warp back to wherever exactly your last death occurred, and hopefully recollect your possessions along with a part of your soul you have

probably left there. Beware, however, for such opportunity comes at a cost - as soon as teleportation is complete you will find yourself almost dead again, and it may not be long before whatever killed you
last time gets you once more.
A type of potion that isn't as widely known as usable as common set.<br2/>Practical applications it can have are fairly obvious. It is mostly useful for long mining sessions, as it allows to tear through rocks and dirt at much faster rate. Besides that, however, it might prove to also be somewhat usable in combat, as it also makes your attacks
slightly faster and easier to chain up in short time.<br2/>Brewing it isn't any difficult - just fuse nether quartz into awkward potion, and that's it.
Its effect can either gain extended length, by fusing some redstone dust...
...or increased power with the use of glowstone.
You can also brew it into splash...
...or lingering types, just like you can any other regular potion.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.molten_heart_: This one serves as an improved version of Fire Resistance potion, should you find yourself willing to invest less common ingredients in order to obtain greater effect.<br2/>Besides granting you complete immunity to fire and lava, it extinguishes you when you are on fire, and improves your sense of surroundings in molten magmatic currents to noticeable extent.
Ultimately, it should make the experience of stewing in lava oceans of the Nether considerably more enjoyable.
Its effect can be extended using redstone dust.
You can also brew it into splash...
...or lingering types, just like you can any other regular potion.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.advanced_brew: Advanced Potions
Ultimate Potion Brewing
Ultimate Strength
Ultimate Invisibility
Ultimate Healing
Ultimate Splash Poison

One of immediate ways Astral Dust may come in handy is in potion brewing. Its unusual properties allow to achieve what was previously thought of as impossible, creating ultimate potions that combine both powerful effect and extended duration.<br2/>Following pages contain examples of effects you may achieve by doing so.
Ultimate potions can be brewed from both extended and, if chosen potion has such variation, empowered version.<br2/>Result will not vary from this.
If potion has both extended and empowered version, its ultimate version will combine best from both. In case with Strength, this means that its ultimate potion will apply Strength II for 8 minutes.
If a potion has only extended version, typically it will have doubled duration of extended version. As seen here, ultimate Invisibility potion applies its effect for 16 minutes.
If a potion has instant effect, it will just receive one additional level of effect. Thus Potion of Healing will apply Instant Health III if brewed into ultimate version.
They can also be brewed from and converted into both splash and lingering versions, via conventional means.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.etherium_armo: Surely, it didn't take you too long to guess that newfound power of etherium might come in handy in an attempt of forging the ultimate armor. Etherium armor might not be truly ultimate, yet by far it surpasses anything you can create or lay claim upon.<br2/>One of its first notable properties is that should you equip it and bear on your

body, the armor itself becomes completely invisible and feels much less of a burden to carry than armor forged from mundane metals. Until something attempts to interact with you or that armor, it's actually possible to entirely forget you even carry it, that's how unnoticeable is its weight for one who bears it.

That ease, however, doesn't mean it's worse at absorbing enemy attacks. It supersedes even netherite armor it how extremely hard it is to penetrate. More than that, it also is unimaginably durable - even the most crushing blows barely leave a scratch on its surface.<br2/>And as if that wasn't enough, individual armor pieces seem to resonate with one another, urging to unleash the metal's inner energy.

Should you carry all four pieces simultaneously, and that resonation achieves its peak, finally being able to manifest itself into powerful shield woven out of sheer energy, protecting its bearer from most projectiles, significantly weakening attacks that it isn't capable of blocking completely, and knocking back whoever attempts to execute these attacks.<br2/>That shield, however, takes a lot of energy to sustain.

It only activates when its bearer somehow manages to get severely wounded, despite outstanding protection of the armor itself. When they remain at their full health and thus can manage to deal with incoming threats without additional measures of protection, the shield is dispelled and etherium slowly replenishes its inner energy, until the need to manifest it arises again.<br2/>It's difficult to not notice the

similarity of that shield to one Wither conjures when brought down to half of its health. That must imply some relation to origin and nature of etherium's power, but you don't seem to have enough clues to put pieces of this story together just yet.<br2/>Following pages contain depictions of how etherium armor can be forged, according to your design.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.xp_scroll.pag: The ethereal substance known as experience often is quite difficult and inconvenient to handle. Though yourself you possess ability to absorb any amount of it, what you do not possess is a possibility to effectively distribute it afterwards.<br2/>The more you absorb and withhold at once, the greater amount arts like enchanting

consume to be performed, at times getting unimaginably wasteful. Even more irritating, once your physical shell gets torn apart, most of your experience simply vanishes, leaving only insignificant morsels left behind.

Should you lay your hands on this magnificent scroll, however, and that frustration will finally come to an end.<br2/>It can quickly and easily absorb your experience, withholding it until you choose to claim it back. Scroll of Ageless Wisdom allows to precisely control how much is transferred back and forth, thus enabling you to manage your precious experience as effectively as you wish, as experience stored in scroll

does not count towards your own total. Just by looking at it, you can conveniently estimate how much experience it stores at any given time.<br2/>While it is active and carried among your other accessories, this scroll also absorbs any experience clumps that might be dropped in large area around you.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.super_magnet_: A long anticipated upgrade of Magnetic Ring, the Ring of Dislocation is better in every way.<br2/>Infused with fraction of mystical energy of The End, it covers area twice as large as its predecessor, and instead of drawing dropped items towards you, it... draws you towards items. In every regard, affected items will behave as

if you were standing right next to them, effectively existing in multiple places at once. This ring also inherits property of its parent, not letting your own items drop unless you completely suppress its power.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.monster_charm: Sometimes those monsters mindlessly wandering in the dark can become great annoyance. Now that you hold power to forge Netherite, more often than not they're reduced from once considerable threat to a slight inconvenience staining your blade. However, at times it still takes a couple strikes to make sure their souls ceased to cling to flesh, and doing so isn't
incredibly rewarding on its own anymore.<br2/>Emblem of Monster Slayer is a perfect charm to aid you in these frequent encounters, saving you a hit or two of your sword.

Creatures slain when bearing it will leave behind more useful stuff you can collect. Should those creatures happen to be monsters, you will also be able to absorb greater part of their life force, in form of experience.<br2/>A couple times you've happened across stories of heroes, who have dedicated their life for once to fighting monsters, yet ended up becoming monsters on their own. Just by looking at the common zombie, however,
you are pretty sure you shall never have to suffer such fate. How could you possibly have anything in common?..
Most of this world's valuable metals and minerals are hidden deep below its surface. Because of that, you often find yourself in need to spend countless hours in damp, cold and dark underground, digging seemingly endless tunnels in search of resources you require.<br2/>This charm may not spare you the burden of having to go

through it, but at least it can make those hours slightly less dark and boringly long. It grants powers that would make any miner jealous, allowing you to tear blocks apart significantly faster than you could otherwise, see in dark

as clearly as in daylight, and be able to reach things with your pickaxe from much further away.<br2/>It might also shift the odds just a bit in your favor in your search of treasures... probably. Maybe that part was only rumors, after all.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.magnet_ring.p: Despite simplicity of its design, Magnetic Ring already holds some arcane power.<br2/>Perhaps not the one that defies creation itself, yet still quite useful - whatever thing might be lying on the ground around you, this ring will bring it towards you, sparing you the labor of walking to it and picking it  up yourself.
One of its notable properties is that items you might attempt to throw away will refuse to leave you, instantly attempting to re-enter your inventory, unless you willingly suppress the ring's power.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.golden_ring.p: A bit more work and about as much of precious gold, and you can reforge mundane iron ring into much shinier and fancier form.<br2/>The only notable property of this accessory, apart from being all shiny and golden, is that it has effect on Piglins similar to wearing gold armor - they will respect you a bit more when seeing this
preciousness on your finger, and won't try to kill as soon as you enter their field of view.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.enchanter_pea: Among many ways you can harness the power of Wither's soul, there is this truly precious pearl, capable of breaking the limits you usually have to cope with when working with Enchanting Table.<br2/>First, it allows you to once and for all forget about having to run to the table twice anytime you want to enchant something, only

because you forgot to bring some Lapis with you the first time. Instead of using Lapis Lazuli, the pearl draws power from within the Ring of the Seven Curses to use it as catalyzer for enchanting process. As a result, the

amount and power of enchantments you will be getting when enchanting anything are significantly higher on average than with normal enchanting.<br2/>This process also allows to achieve what was thought to be impossible before - produce unique treasure enchantments on your gear, such as Mending, right within that Enchanting Table of yours. Unfortunately, there also is a chance you will get some curses instead,
which you normally wouldn't have gotten, so this latter ability is somewhat of a double-edged sword.
Ever since you have chosen to bear the Ring of the Seven Curses, you pondered the possibility of getting rid of it - if not to actually do this, then at least to be aware if it exists. Though materials it is forged from are by no measure indestructible, physical incarnation of the ring is just a mere fraction of its metaphysical power and nature. Tendrils of its corruption
reach deep within your soul, intertwining your immortal being with entity of the ring itself, and thus all curses and blessings it yields.<br2/>This connection between you is exactly what makes it so

persistent, inseparable from you even in death. As much as to certain extent you are able to draw and harness power from within the ring, the ring is capable of drawing power from within you in order to reinforce its physical form, as well as the link tightly holding that form on your finger. The only thing it seems to remain barely susceptible to would appear to be extreme heat, but that connection ensures it cannot be permanently destroyed without

your own body being destroyed just as permanently. And since you apparently possess the ability to create and inhabit new vessel after destruction of the old one, the ring does either.<br2/>However, now that you defeated the Wither and harvested sheer essence of its corrupted soul, the possibility to surmount such obstacle revealed itself. The Unholy Stone symbolizes the connection between you and Ring of the Seven Curses,

manifested and exposed in somewhat fragile physical form for as long as you keep the stone close to you. This allows you to exploit ring's only vulnerability, by willingly meeting your demise in specific, somewhat ritualistic manner.<br2/>With this stone at your disposal, travel to the dimension of blazing heat and lost souls, known as the Nether. Wander amongst its blasted, twisted landscape,

climbing cliffs and ledges to look down from them - until you discover an ocean of seething lava beneath your feet, as vast and deep as you can find. Hold your breath for a while, before releasing it for the last time, and leap into the midst of blazing ocean below, letting your body drown into the molten rock and be consumed by fire.<br2/>Should everything be executed correctly, the ring shall melt and be destroyed forever.

The liberation from its chains doesn't come cheap, however - it is only possible because you expose part of your soul entangled with it through the Unholy Stone. In order for this ritual to be successful, that part must be destroyed first, otherwise it would simply not be possible. But at least with this sacrifice made you will never see that cursed ring again... unless of course it would turn out there was more than one in your world, which is not very likely.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.heaven_scroll: As any other demigod or human once did, ever since the beginning of your journey you dreamed to transcend the limits of your vulnerable body. That dream, among all other attributes, included freely roaming the skies of this world, alike a god above all other.<br2/>Well, this scroll might not allow you to roam all the
skies. But with the immense might of the Nether Star powering it, it can do a thing or two.<br2/>Should you find yourself in the presence of an active Beacon, penetrating skies with

its vivid lightbeam - and Gift of the Heaven will grant you highly controllable and convenient ability to float and fly around, as long as you don't wonder to far away from beacon's arcane aura.<br2/>That aura, unfortunately, isn't strong enough on its own to continuously drain much required energy for powering your flight from it. The scroll will slowly, yet steadily consume experience you absorbed, to be able to keep
you in the air.<br2/>You are pretty sure there must be a way to improve its power and overcome the limitations it has, but for a while longer that's what you are left to work with.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.fabulous_scro: Your expectations were, eventually, confirmed. Now that the gate to The End is open and its boundless reaches have fell before your superior might, you were finally able to design an improved version of Gift of the Heaven.<br2/>One that may not eliminate limits of its precursor entirely, but at least expands them significantly.

This scroll does allow you to freely fly across the skies of all worlds and dimension, without need to stay close the Beacon. Powering your flight with experience alone is quite expensive though, so don't expect your ascension to last

nearly as long as it would within the beacon's range.<br2/>On the other hand, Grace of the Creator is capable of draining beacon's power much more efficiently, and should you choose to stay within that range, you will not have to sacrifice any experience at all to remain above all others.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.escape_scroll:
Though death has proven to be only a temporary inconvenience for a demigod like you, sometimes this inconvenience takes great toll.
Much greater than you would like to pay - depending on where you die, your precious gear, forged from finest materials and collected from all corners of the Overworld, can be lost to Oblivion or incredibly difficult to recover.

This scroll is an insurance against such happening.<br2/>It cannot protect its bearer from death, but should their life be taken, whatever they would drop in place of their death will instead be taken

back to the respawn point, across any distances and dimensions. The scroll itself will remain where its bearer was killed, but unlike items you would normally drop, it will not burn, or fall into the Void where you might've met your demise, or vanish into nothingness if you leave it unattended for too long.<br2/>Only the hand of demigod, though not necessarily yours alone, can ever claim it back.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.ender_ring.pa: Ender Chest has proven to be extremely useful thing, allowing you to access items of your choice across any distances and dimensions. Unlike items you may carry on yourself, those in your ender chest are not endangered when your physical shell gets destroyed.<br2/>There is a slight inconvenience to it, however -

the need to carry around that massive chest, chucking it down whenever you want to pull something out of its extradimensional depths, and then removing it with incredibly delicate tool, unless you want it to be

shattered into obsidian pieces you once so carefully fused together.<br2/>Ring of Ender is designed exactly to solve this issue, allowing you to tear the fabric of space and access contents of your ender chest with nothing but sheer force of will.<br2/>Just don't forget to pull your hand out of when you release the rift.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.arcane_scroll: Creation of arcane scrolls, besides writing materials and mundane blank scroll, will usually take a couple arcane ingredients, to make sure that the scroll you create does something more than just exist. They can be carried around like any other accessories.<br2/>These are unlikely contribute as much to your image of terrifying, mighty mage,

especially given that books were invented a long time ago by now. Yet that matters not given how vast are practical possibilities they may provide, if designed and put together masterfully.<br2/>Weirdly, it's difficult to come by a scroll used for just storing writings, even among the most ancient samples of literature.<br2/>Perhaps, it's not such an obvious design after all?..
Here is outlined the way to craft an empty scroll.<br2/>Might not be extremely useful on its own, but it serves as a base for creation of arcane scrolls.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.darkest_scrol: Found withing the treasures of dangerous Bastions, those rolls of black-stained pergament draw little suspicion at first glance. Yet in truth they are infused with some unknown sort of dark magic, one that seems strangely familiar to one that empowers Ring of the Seven Curses.<br2/>That magic however lays dormant within its vessel,
a raw, slumbering energy seemingly waiting to be awoken and exploited. Perhaps the Darkest Scroll could serve as base for creation of new, more powerful arcane scrolls?
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.avarice_scrol:
One another relic harnessing the boundless strength of the Seven Curses, this elegant scroll is designed to fulfill the boundless inner greed you so carefully conceal within your soul.
Its primary effect is an ability to confuse minds of the creatures you trade or barter with, into misguessing true price and benefit of the deal... much in your favor.

Piglins seem to be most affected by this ability, with their helpless affection by gold. Not only this allows the scroll to overcome the effect of the Second Curse and render them neutral in your regard, as they normally are

towards anyone who bears enough golden equipment on them, but it also makes bartering with those creatures about twice as beneficial on average, allowing you to get anywhere from normal item quantity to three times the quantity in exchange from any single barter.<br2/>Villagers are also affected by this scroll's ability, even though not as much as Piglins are - stable 35<percent/> discount on every trade is about as much

as you can get from their little avid person.<br2/>Apart from this, you also get a slight chance of having an entire Emerald materialize into existence right from within your avaricious dreams whenever you happen to slay any living creature, and <&l>+1 Fortune Level<clear/> which will doubtlessly help you get your hands on some more riches anytime you feel like descending into the mines.
Just don't let that greed of yours take over your mind, and you'll be fine.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.infinimeal.pa: One another way to harness the power that rests within Heart of the Earth, this arcane substance embodies the power of nature itself, with its everlasting desire to spread its roots across the earth, to grow and thrive no matter what.<br2/>Letting it come in contact with most forms of plantlife is enough to significantly

accelerate their growth, similar to the effect produced when using Bone Meal. Unlike Bone Meal, however, you only need a mere grains of it to achieve such effect. Left alone, it seems to be able to draw power from surrounding

nature, growing and replenishing itself in quantity after being used - though never to more than there was created originally.<br2/>It also works on certain plants that normal fertilizers have no effect on, specifically Sugar Cane, Cacti, Vines and Nether Wart.
With a fine selection of arcane ingredients, those which contain the power of other dimensions, you can alter the earthly nature of Heart of the Sea, transforming it into something different... Vastly more powerful.<br2/>The power of cosmos itself now rests at the palm of your hand. Only time will tell what unimaginable feats can be
achieved with it, what fabulous artifacts can be powered with its reality-bending energies.<br2/>But one thing is for certain - the world will tremble beneath the steps of their bearer.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.abyssal_heart: When this unearthly abomination fell into your hands for the first time, description-defying mix of feelings have overcome your mind, among which there was a place for terror and excitement, admiration and disgust. The gaze of its lonely eye befell you with intent impossible to comprehend, but once initial wave of emotions retreated - you have

concluded that it poses no threat to you.<br2/>Still, you know not what it truly is, and where it came from. Perhaps your insufferable existence, and efforts to live in spite of Seven Curses were noticed by some unnameable eldritch power, and through your

damnable being it have chosen to channel itself into the world. Perhaps it is a mere accident, a fluke in reality itself that allowed something like this to appear. Perhaps it is your ailing mind that have conceived this horror in some nightmarish fever, and with its growth - corruption of the curses have managed to manifest it into the mortal realm?<br2/>Perhaps it's best to never know, for some truths are much

more unsettling than anything a man's imagination can come up with.<br2/>Regardless, now you are the rightful owner of this thing. And it will not be long before you can put it to some unimaginably violent, frightening use... The world will suffer tenfold for all the suffering it caused to you.
Though many have sought this relic, it appears that you are among the few who found. In fact, it was not even that hard at all. Though a journey itself was nothing short of a feat, once you have made your way to the End City and opened the first treasure chest - there it was, awaiting you.<br2/>It certainly has connection to Seven Curses, but you cannot

begin to imagine how circumstances aligned in such a way that it was in that exact chest you have opened, and no other. Determinism was never among your favored beliefs, and yet... perhaps it was destiny?<br2/>At any rate, the taste is divine, and the ability it has
to empower you to bear another ring is undeniably useful.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.eternal_bindi: The similarity of this curse's name to Curse of Binding is no accident - for it does exactly the same thing as the latter, preventing you from removing armor and accessories from yourself once equipped. The twist, however, is in the fact that items bearing this one will persist with you even across death. This might be less severe in the case of armor, since sooner or later

it will break; for most accessories, however, with this curse applied you condemn yourself to bear them until you die permanently or until the end of time, whichever comes first.<br2/>Unlike most other curses, the only way to obtain this one seems to be by using classical
Enchanting Table, empowered by the Enchanter's Pearl.
Applicable only to armor, this curse adds an aftermath to the damage you would take from your enemies. Severe debuffs will befall you for every hit that you take, the greater the damage - the greater the debuffs.<br2/>Hopefully, the chance of such happening is only about one in ten for every piece of armor with this curse that you bear.

As per usual, you can occasionally find items bearing this curse among ancient treasures which you periodically pillage. It might be useful to power Scroll of a Thousand Curses if you have such, but whether or not the tradeoff is worth it is for you to judge.
Enchanting Table, empowered by the Enchanter's Pearl.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.the_infinitum: It is conceived. In union with this dark, flesh-covered book, with horror that its pages conceal, you will wreak havoc upon those who threatened you.<br2/>Upon those who laughed at you, those who underestimated you, those who undertaken every effort to break you, to cleanse the world of your presence, be they disgusted by corruption that you bear or simply

viewing you as an easy prey. For you are the writings that cannot be burned, knowledge that cannot be forgotten, truth that cannot be denied.<br2/>You will reveal to this realm what it have so persistently
attempted to unmake and erase, you will engrave upon the tablets of eternity that reality which it have tried to hide.<br2/>You will teach them all a lesson they shall never forget.
One of the toughest lessons you have learned ever since first equipping Ring of the Seven Curses is that Endermen are no longer able to tolerate your existence. They have haunted you ever since - screeching, frightening horrors, chasing you in the night under the stars, and in smothering darkness of twisted salt-soaked caverns beneath the ground, possessed by

unbendable desire to decimate your being. Before long, you have accepted that to restore neutral relations with them is by all means an impossible undertaking, and abandoned any and every attempt to achieve such.

If that was the end of it - perhaps, to submit yourself to such fate and perpetually suffer their nightmarish onslaught would become nothing more than another part of your routine, and you would bear it with acceptance you have achieved in bearing all other curses.<br2/>If only... Now that The End beckons you to meet its challenges, traverse its lands and claim its treasures, the Endermen have become an

obstacle in your way equal to which you did not face yet. For that dimension is inhabited fully by their kind, and thus, to even survive entering it seems a feat beyond the limits of your power as a demigod.<br2/>Perhaps, it is time to recede, to finally abandon your hope of surmounting this world's challenges and harnessing corruption of the curses. But the battle may yet be won. With this sword, and your sheer strength of will you may yet
stand victorious. For if peace cannot be made... it can only mean war.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.the_cube.name: Non-Euclidean Cube
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.the_cube.page: Many of those who laid their claim on six mighty spellstones have pondered the possibility to, perhaps, somehow combine their powers into an artifact of might never before witnessed. Many have tried, and many have failed... Until now.<br2/>At last, you discovered a way to achieve such a feat. With power of the cosmos manifest in your hands, you may force

elements into such form that defies reality itself. The pinnacle of your exploration and research, it will become a symbol of your superiority over any mortal creature that ever walked the lands of three great worlds.
With its innumerable powers, even death you shall now transcend... For insofar as this cube will last forever, you are in the presence of immortality.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.desolation_ri: You can scarce comprehend presence imposed upon reality by Heart of the Abyss, but, as you have recently discovered, comprehension is not necessary for the ability to make use of it. Among few equally wonderful and terrible things that can draw power from it, there is this ring - even more nightmarish, perhaps, than Ring of the Seven Curses, in its
unnameable nature.<br2/>It offers to conveniently fulfill your gnawing desire to set yourself free of necessity to endlessly slaughter creatures that could once tolerate your presence,

but have lost such ability soon as you submitted yourself to the burden of Seven Curses... By erasing them from the very existence surrounding you.<br2/>The cost of such reality-bending power is perilous, however, as should you decide that you desire it - you will be bound to it forevermore. And as you know by now, void can be more unbearable than even most frightening, ever-present threat...
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.astral_potato: In the everlasting battle of carrot lovers against potato enjoyers, the latter were bound to find themselves at a steady disadvantage. After all, what is a baked potato, in spite of all its deliciousness, in the face of immense nutritional value and reinvigorating effects of a mere carrot, albeit covered in some gold?

Today, we say "no more". The latest culinary invention of the cosmos itself shall fulfill two purposes - satiating our hunger, and becoming a symbol of our supremacy in the war on carrot. The appropriate name we have given to this

great delicacy will no doubt further mock and demoralize our enemy. What a shame would it be for them to find out they were utterly defeated by "Teleportato"? What horror will such awareness paint upon their faces?<br2/>It won't be long before we find out...
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.cosmic_cake.p: There is only one issue in the mundane cake, one final flaw that prevents it from becoming perfect - it always ends, as imminently as life of a mortal man. At last, you conceived a way to rectify this annoying imperfection, letting you enjoy its creamy grace forevermore.<br2/>Imbued with primordial power, incorporating alien delicacy and spiced up with elemental

energies, this cake defies the flow of time, reversing entropy itself to restore its glorious, palatable form. However much you submit yourself to the sin of gluttony, it will always recover from any devouring assault of yours.

Who can withstand in the face of such deliciousness, who can resist the desire to exchange power, influence, riches and even life itself for becoming submerged in ceaseless, infinite act of consumption? Those things are temporary after all... but the cake, the cake is eternal.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.eldritch_amul: Though Amulet of Ascension is perfected and pure in its form, it may yet be empowered further. At the cost of sacrificing the purity, sure, but why would a cursed being such as you fret over this loss anyway?<br2/>The jumble of flesh known as Heart of the Abyss will happily latch onto your amulet, corrupting it into such a

twisted form that defies description. Once vivid, elegant stone at its core is replaced with a glossy, onyx-like eye, gazing upon you and the world alike with uneasy implication and unknowable intent. Even madman would deny

this abomination the touch to himself, but you welcome it upon your neck. For whereas madman is a victim of his own delusional perception of the world, you see it now for what it is...<br2/>And it is much more terrible than all the eyes of infinite abyss.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.ascension_amu: By now, you are aware that Enigmatic Amulet in your possession is not unique, and in fact such a thing is granted to many other demigods beyond your time and space. There seems to exist a few variations of it, with different colors and different powers. What exactly determined the color in your current possession is unknown, but they all seem to mean
something and be connected in some way.<br2/>With power contained within Heart of the Cosmos you can transform your amulet into the form of unwitnessed might and ambition. Proudly named Amulet
of Ascension, it will grant you abilities of all possible colors...<br2/>Fate may have decided the beginning of your existence in this realm, but the end of it is yours to shape.
With enough deaths, terrible novelty of losing parts of your soul with each one have withered away, leaving only the troublesome experience of locating places of your demise in an effort to recollect them. Those places often fall to be in the most unnavigable parts of the world, as if to incur frustration of such extent that it be named another curse of ring bearer.

As many other curses, however, this one too can be overcome. With this thing in your pocket, you will never again have to rely on your failing memory alone to aid you in search of your soul crystals. It will conveniently point you to the

nearest one, wherever it is, so long as you are in the right dimension.<br2/>Notably, there is one place where it fails to work, and its needle spins uncontrollably at alarming speeds - Soul Sand Valley. How many forgotten souls must wander that damned place to produce such a strong interference? Perhaps, it is a mystery better left unsolved.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.curse_transpo: Bearing the Seven Curses, you have acquired ability to draw power from curses bound to some of the ancient gear you find in your explorations, and even create such yourself with the help of Enchanter's Pearl. But they still are a great nuisance at times, as even though you can transpose them from one item from another, so far you had no way of separating them from
enchantments when doing so.<br2/>With this little invention, however, your curse management abilities should improve significantly. It offers a way to separate curses and only curses from any item of
your equipment; not a cheap one at that, but a way nonetheless.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.enigmatic_ely: Combined with some fireworks, Elytra provides an outstanding means of transportation, easily outpacing any horse, boat or minecart alike. There are only two major concerns surrounding its prolonged use - swift weardown, and necessity to maintain steady supply of fireworks.<br2/>Majestic Elytra resolves both of them. It offers remarkable

durability, and can use enderic energies to propel the wearer forward during the flight at their wish, in a manner not dissimilar to fireworks. Doing so puts greater strain on hardness of the elytra, but insofar it can

be repaired with etherium in conventional anvil - that should not be too much of a concern.<br2/>Apart from that, it is covered with much more vibrant color patterns, leaving nobody in doubt regarding its magnificent, extraordinary qualities.
Where exactly this so called "blood of gods" comes from is a question yet unanswered, and perhaps better left as such. Now that you have some at your disposal, however, you can consume it to increase your body's ability to channel arcane energies, allowing you to equip one more of those precious charms that magnify your abilities in one way or another.

The relic of such rarity is almost impossible to find, and you cannot help but wonder how it happened that one ended up in your hands. Perhaps, you were drawn together by your divine nature, or perhaps some greater power directed you towards it?..
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.enigmatic_eye: An unexpected find among piles of treasure and junk, this eye have immediately consumed your attention with its distinguished unearthly form. You could not resist the temptation of curiosity, and have chosen to awake it from slumber that lasted many centuries at least, and perhaps even many millennia.<br2/>Creator of the eye have soon

made himself known to you, and now that he is aware of your presence in this world - the eye itself is no longer necessary for him to observe and speak to you. He follows your footsteps since, remarking on things now and then. So far communication between you remains entirely unilateral, and thus it is hard

to establish what he is, and what motive he has to scrupulously contemplate your every move.<br2/>What can be said for sure is that he is no stranger to the world you currently inhabit, nor to higher beings such as you. Most certainly he once walked these lands himself, but extent of his participation in their past history remains a mystery yet. Much as where he is now, why he have chosen to speak to you, and what
expectations he places upon your journey.<br2/>For now, you can only hope that in time he will supply you with desired answers.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.insignia.name: Charming Insignia
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.insignia.page: Although this little trinket will not afford you increased strength, speed or will - there is more to it than appears at first glance. It allows you to conceal your name in the eyes of other demigods, and replace it with the one of your liking. Conveniently, it does not reduce the amount of other charms you can bear beside it.<br2/>The obvious way to make use

of it would be deception, but potential here is unfortunately limited, as insignia will only affect the name others see when they observe you in person. Besides, those who possess or are connected with certain godlike powers may

still be able to recognize your true name.<br2/>Another way is to distinguish yourself. This is where opportunities are limitless, especially considering that fancy colors and styles The Architect's Inkwell is known to be capable of producing are fully applicable to the alternative name you can engrave upon your insignia.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.end_anchor.pa: However barren and desolate lands of The End are, there exist reasons why one could want to dwell there. Mostly two - to seek something, or to hide from something. Until recently there was a minor inconvenience getting in the way of such desires, but with invention of Dimensional Anchor the challenge of binding the point of your resurrection to somewhere
within those lands is finally overcome.<br2/>Dimensional Anchor works in the manner not dissimilar to that of Respawn Anchor, but will require Ender Pearls to be recharged instead of much

cheaper Glowstone. As a repayment for increased maintenance costs - it can function where Respawn Anchor cannot, and has a noticeable chance to not spend a charge upon your revival. Things such as Potion of Recall will work with it much as they do with its predecessor, and Dispenser can still be used to automate recharging.<br2/>Only one thing remains of concern. Even for higher beings, space between worlds

is not the safest of places to traverse, most so when stripped of flesh... You cannot help but wonder what terrible places await those who are mislead by the light of their beacons, and what grisly fate befalls them in there.
The very bones of the universe, both celestial and eldritch, lay at your fingertips. And yet, you still crave more...<br2/>Fortunately, the unthinkable nature of Heart of the Abyss can be employed in this pursuit of yours. Less fortunately, another kind of insatiable craving now plagues your mind and body alike.

This boundless hunger demands that you keep hunting for all manner of creature that walk the lands of this, and many other worlds. Consumed by it, you cannot quite tell if this influence fully comes from the artifact that you have forged,

or it has become so deeply engraved in your soul that it will continue haunting you even without it.<br2/>The maw of The Voracious Pan stays ever-open, leading into what you presume is a stomach belonging to a vast entity of incomprehensible dimensions. Has this being granted you the Heart of the Abyss, or is it merely an entity that shares the same insatiable appetite you suffer from? It might be better not to know.

The promise of The Forbidden Fruit to quench any hunger once and for all is more tempting than ever, but you remain cautious. Things are never quite so simple for a cursed being such as yourself, and once you lose your ability to hunger, some other calamity will surely take its place.<br2/>Few dare to cross paths with you now. Ones that witnessed flesh torn and consumed, hearts crushed and forgotten, and veins sucked dry of blood
in your never-ending feast, are shaken. Those you struck down have not returned to tell the tales.<br2/>What, or indeed who, will be your next meal?
book.enigmaticlegacy.landing_text: In front of you lies the well of great knowledge, a place where some of this world's greatest mysteries belong, scrupulously researched and carefully cataloged.<br2/>As your journey continues and the world reveals itself to you, you may revisit and behold knowledge you gathered within these pages.

book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.cosmic_scroll: The might of this rumor-shadowed scroll is denied to most demigods, even those who have approached the godship rather close. Who is permitted to possess it is at the discretion of The Architect himself, and as rumors would have it - the journey to $(l:https://discord.gg/fuWK8ns)his domain$(/l) is long and full of dangers, and to be noticed by that godly being is an honor few of its dwellers ever had.
Those who did, however, are awarded with power which has no equal; for the world to bask in their glory, and for them to spread the faith to the ears and eyes of others.
